post.description: Runs a bounded pass immediately (most recent threads and messages) and, the first time, starts a background backfill of the full history. `backfilling: true` means more conversations will keep landing in the inbox for the next few minutes — poll this list to see them arrive. Webhooks keep the inbox current, so a manual sync is accepted at most once every 2 minutes per account: within that window nothing is fetched and the current inbox comes back with `throttled: true`, `lastSyncAt` and `retryAfterSeconds`. `rateLimited: true` means the platform quota cut the pass short (what was read is kept). Answers 429 while the shared Meta API quota is nearly exhausted.

info.title: PlugKit API
info.description: One API to publish, schedule and message across Instagram, Facebook, Threads, WhatsApp, TikTok, Telegram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn and Bluesky — and to run Meta and Google ads.

interval.description: Billing period. `year` charges 10 months for 12 (two months free).

redirectUrl.description: Where Whop sends the customer back after checkout.

capUsd.description: Monthly cap on X pay-per-call spend, in USD. Null falls back to the default cap ($20) — there is no "unlimited": to spend more, set a higher number. At 80% you get a warning; at 100% background analytics and inbox polling pause — publishing keeps working, so a scheduled post is never held back over a fraction of a cent.

name.description: Company or full name printed on invoices

email.description: L'adresse avec laquelle l'invité se connecte à PlugKit. Le workspace apparaît dans son sélecteur à sa première connexion sous cette adresse.

role.description: `member` accède à toutes les données du workspace mais pas à la facturation. `admin` peut en plus changer l'abonnement, le plafond de dépense X et inviter d'autres personnes.

`member` : la portée de données du workspace, sans la facturation. `admin` : tout ce que le propriétaire peut faire — abonnement, plafond de dépense X, invitations. Le propriétaire lui-même n'a pas de rôle : il ne peut pas être retiré.

profileId.description: Profile the account is attached to

externalId.description: Account id on the platform (Instagram business account id / WhatsApp phone number id)

accessToken.description: Platform token (Instagram long-lived / WhatsApp system user)

accountId.description: Account to absorb: its posts and conversations move onto the account in the path, then it is deleted.

analytics.description: Allow analytics reads on this X account. X charges $0.005 per post read and $0.010 per user read.

inboxSync.description: Allow background inbox polling on this X account. X charges $0.010 per DM read.

acknowledgeCost.description: Required to turn either switch ON: confirms the caller has seen what X charges and accepts that these calls are re-billed at cost. Refused without it. Turning a switch OFF never needs it.

objective.description: Meta only, and required there. Ignored on Google Ads.

status.description: PAUSED by default: a campaign created running starts spending immediately.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in minor units of the ad account currency (2000 = €20.00). Set it here for campaign budget optimization, or on the ad set instead.

lifetimeBudget.description: Lifetime budget in minor units of the account currency.

bidStrategy.description: Meta: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP… Google: MAXIMIZE_CLICKS (default), MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS or MANUAL_CPC.

channelType.description: Google only: campaign type. Only SEARCH can be created.

countries.description: Google only: targeted countries (ISO codes). Defaults to FR — a Google campaign without location targeting serves worldwide.

languages.description: Google only: targeted languages. Defaults to all.

containsEuPoliticalAdvertising.description: Google only: self-declaration required by Google for every new campaign. false by default.

specialAdCategories.description: Special ad categories (CREDIT, EMPLOYMENT, HOUSING, ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS, ONLINE_GAMBLING_AND_GAMING). Empty means none — declaring wrongly gets the campaign rejected at Meta review.

dailyBudget.description: Minor units of the account currency.

lifetimeBudget.description: Minor units of the account currency.

campaignId.description: Campaign the ad set belongs to.

dailyBudget.description: Minor units of the account currency.

lifetimeBudget.description: Minor units of the account currency.

bidAmount.description: Bid cap in minor units of the account currency.

bidStrategy.description: Meta bid strategy. Defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP when bidAmount is set, LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP otherwise.

destinationType.description: Where the ad leads, passed through as-is (e.g. ON_POST to promote a Page post, WEBSITE).

dsaBeneficiary.description: Advertiser shown in the Ad Library, required by Meta for ads reaching the EU (DSA). Defaults to the ad account setting, then to its Business Manager name.

dsaPayor.description: Who pays for the ads, required by Meta for ads reaching the EU (DSA). Same default as dsaBeneficiary.

targeting.description: Meta targeting spec, passed through as-is. Defaults to France if omitted.

promotedObject.description: What the ad set optimizes towards (page, pixel, application…), passed through as-is.

keywords.description: Google only: keywords created with the ad group.

dailyBudget.description: Minor units of the account currency.

lifetimeBudget.description: Minor units of the account currency.

bidAmount.description: Minor units of the account currency.

adSetId.description: Ad set the ad runs in.

objectStoryId.description: Meta: existing Page post to turn into the creative, as `{page-id}_{post-id}`. Required when creativeId is absent.

headlines.description: Google only (responsive search ad): 3 to 15 headlines, 30 characters max each.

descriptions.description: Google only: 2 to 4 descriptions, 90 characters max each.

finalUrls.description: Google only: landing page of the ad.

path1.description: Google only: display path, 15 chars max.

path2.description: Google only: display path, 15 chars max.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in minor units of the account currency (2000 = €20.00).

status.description: PAUSED by default: nothing spends without an explicit go.

gclid.description: Google click id captured on the landing page.

email.description: Plain text; hashed (SHA-256) by PlugKit before sending.

phone.description: E.164 (+33612345678); hashed (SHA-256) by PlugKit before sending.

value.description: Conversion value in MAJOR units (49.90), unlike budgets.

orderId.description: Order or lead id; Google deduplicates on it.

adUserDataConsent.description: End-user consent for ad user data (required in the EEA). GRANTED by default.

validateOnly.description: Check the request at Google without importing anything.

contactHandle.description: Contact identifier on the platform (Instagram PSID / WhatsApp wa_id)

externalConversationId.description: Conversation id on the platform (defaults to contactHandle)

language.description: Language code of the approved template (default en_US)

variables.description: Values for the {{1}}, {{2}}… placeholders of the body, in order

components.description: Raw Meta components (header, buttons). Escape hatch: overrides `variables`.

text.description: Text content of the message. Optional when `template` is given — the template carries the content, and the text is then only what the inbox shows.

template.description: WhatsApp only: send an approved template instead of free-form text. Required past the 24h messaging window; ignored by other platforms.

type.description: Inferred from the URL when omitted.

altText.description: Alternative text (accessibility) of an image, 1,000 characters max. Applied on Instagram (single image and carousel images), Facebook Pages (photos), Threads and LinkedIn; ignored for videos and by the other platforms.

thumbnail.description: Cover image (URL) of a video: custom thumbnail on YouTube, cover of an Instagram reel. Ignored for images and by the other platforms (TikTok takes `coverTimestampMs` instead).

customContent.description: Text used on this platform instead of the post content (e.g. a shorter version for X).

customMedia.description: Media used on this platform instead of the post media.

productId.description: Product id from the Instagram shop catalog, as returned by GET /shopping/{accountId}/products.

x.description: Horizontal position of the tag on a photo, from 0 (left) to 1 (right). Ignored on a video or reel. Defaults to the centre — the creator can move it from the Instagram app.

y.description: Vertical position of the tag on a photo, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom). Ignored on a video or reel.

username.description: Public Instagram username, with or without @

x.description: Horizontal position on a photo, from 0 (left) to 1 (right). Ignored on a video.

y.description: Vertical position on a photo, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom). Ignored on a video.

options.description: 2 to 4 choices (25 characters max each on X, 30 on LinkedIn).

durationMinutes.description: How long the poll stays open, 5 minutes to 7 days (default 1 day). X uses it as is; LinkedIn rounds it up to 1, 3 or 7 days.

question.description: LinkedIn only: the poll question (140 characters max). Defaults to the start of the post text.

profileId.description: Profile that owns the post. Optional: inferred from the target accounts, and only required when they belong to several profiles.

title.description: Title of the post. Required by YouTube (100 characters max) and ignored by platforms that have no title.

content.description: Text / caption of the post. REQUIRED, except when `asStory` is set and every target is an Instagram or Facebook account: a story has no caption.

accountIds.description: Target account ids — the short form. Use `platforms` instead to tailor the content per platform. Exactly one of the two is required.

platforms.description: Targets with per-platform overrides. Exactly one of `platforms` and `accountIds` is required.

mediaItems.description: Media of the post. This is the canonical shape: it carries the type, alt text and thumbnail, which `mediaUrls` cannot.

mediaUrls.description: Legacy shorthand: a list of URLs, converted to `mediaItems` (type inferred from the extension). Ignored when `mediaItems` is provided.

scheduledFor.description: Scheduled date (ISO 8601). Without an offset ("2027-01-01T12:00:00") the time is read in `timezone`; with an offset or a Z it is an absolute instant. The post moves to `scheduled` and is published automatically at that time, unless `isDraft` is set: the date is then only the planned date of the draft.

timezone.description: IANA timezone `scheduledFor` is expressed in (e.g. "Europe/Paris"). Ignored when the date already carries an offset.

isDraft.description: Save the post as a draft, never published automatically. Wins over `publishNow` and `scheduledFor`. With `scheduledFor`, the date is kept as the planned date of the draft (shown on the calendar, may be in the past) and nothing is published at that time.

asDraft.description: TikTok only: send the video (or the photo carousel) to the creator's inbox as a draft (Content Posting API, `video.upload` scope) instead of publishing it directly. The creator finishes the post in the TikTok app.

trialReel.description: Instagram only: publish the video as a trial reel — shown to NON-followers only, never to your own followers, until you choose to release it from the Instagram app. Requires a video and an account with at least 1,000 followers. Ignored by the other platforms.

asStory.description: Instagram and Facebook Pages: publish to the STORY instead of the feed. A story lasts 24 hours, carries no caption (`content` is ignored, and may be omitted when every target is an Instagram or Facebook account) and takes exactly one media — on Instagram a JPEG image (8 MB max) or an MP4/MOV video of 3 to 60 seconds (100 MB max), on a Facebook Page an image (10 MB max) or an MP4 video of 3 to 90 seconds. Cannot be combined with `trialReel`. Ignored by the other platforms, which have no story API: TikTok does not expose one, LinkedIn and YouTube retired theirs.

trialGraduation.description: Instagram only, with `trialReel`: how the trial ends. `MANUAL` — you decide in the Instagram app whether to release the reel to your followers. `SS_PERFORMANCE` — Instagram releases it on its own if the trial performs well.

shareToFeed.description: Instagram only, reels: also show the reel in the account feed, not just in the Reels tab.

productTags.description: Instagram only: products from the account’s Instagram shop to tag on the post — the tiles shown under a photo or in a reel’s "In this reel" panel. Requires product tagging to be enabled on the account (`GET /shopping/{accountId}/status`); product ids come from `GET /shopping/{accountId}/products`. Up to 20 tags on a photo, 30 on a reel; Instagram allows 25 tagged posts per account per 24 hours. Tags are applied right after the post goes live: if Meta refuses them, the post still publishes and the target reports why.

collaborators.description: Instagram only: up to 3 usernames invited as collaborators. Once they accept in the app, the post appears on their profile too. Feed photos, reels and carousels; not stories.

userTags.description: Instagram only: public accounts to tag on the media (up to 20). On a photo each tag sits at `x`/`y`; on a reel or a story the position is ignored. On a carousel, the tags go on the first media.

locationId.description: Instagram only: id of the Facebook Page of a place, shown as the location of the post (photo, reel or carousel; not stories). Find it with the Facebook Pages Search API.

firstComment.description: Instagram, Facebook Pages and Threads: a comment the account posts on its own post right after publishing (hashtags kept out of the caption, a link, a follow-up). Not on stories. If the platform refuses the comment, the post stays published and the target reports why.

coverTimestampMs.description: TikTok video and Instagram reel: the frame used as cover, in milliseconds from the start. On a reel, a `thumbnail` on the media wins over it.

coverIndex.description: TikTok photo carousel: position of the cover photo, 0 being the first image.

autoAddMusic.description: TikTok photo carousel: add a recommended music track. Set to false to publish it silent.

youtubeTags.description: YouTube only: keyword tags of the video (500 characters in total, commas included; extra tags are dropped).

youtubeCategoryId.description: YouTube only: category id of the video (e.g. "22" People & Blogs, "27" Education, "28" Science & Technology).

madeForKids.description: YouTube only: declare whether the video is made for kids (COPPA). When omitted, the channel default applies.

notifySubscribers.description: YouTube only: notify the channel subscribers about the new video. Set to false for a quiet upload.

replyControl.description: Threads only: who can reply. Takes precedence over `allowComment` (which only maps false to `mentioned_only`).

topicTag.description: Threads only: topic of the post, 1 to 50 characters, without periods or ampersands.

linkAttachment.description: Threads only: a link shown as a preview card under a text post. Ignored when the post carries media.

poll.description: Poll attached to a post without media: Threads, X and LinkedIn. Ignored when the post carries media, and by the other platforms.

xReplySettings.description: X only: who can reply. Takes precedence over `allowComment` (false maps to `mentionedUsers`).

linkedinVisibility.description: LinkedIn only: who sees the post — anyone, 1st-degree connections only, or signed-in LinkedIn members.

allowComment.description: Let other users comment. TikTok: forced off when the creator's own settings already disable comments. Threads: false limits replies to mentioned accounts. Instagram: false turns comments off on the published post (not on stories).

allowDuet.description: TikTok only: let other users Duet the video. Forced off when the creator's own TikTok settings already disable duets.

allowStitch.description: TikTok only: let other users Stitch the video. Forced off when the creator's own TikTok settings already disable stitches.

privacy.description: Visibility of the published video. YouTube maps it directly (`unlisted` = reachable by link but not listed). TikTok has no `unlisted`, so both `unlisted` and `private` publish as SELF_ONLY — visible to the account owner only. The other platforms ignore it.

tiktokPrivacyLevel.description: TikTok only: the exact privacy level the creator picked, among those returned by `GET /accounts/{id}/publish-options`. Takes precedence over `privacy`, which only knows three values where TikTok has four. Rejected if the creator is not allowed to use it.

promotionalContent.description: TikTok only: the video promotes the creator's own brand, product or business. TikTok labels it « Promotional content ».

paidPartnership.description: TikTok and X: the post promotes a third party as a paid partnership. TikTok labels it « Paid partnership », which wins over « Promotional content » when both are declared, and refuses it with a private (SELF_ONLY) visibility; X sets `paid_partnership`; Instagram sets its « Paid partnership » label when the account has a Facebook authorization (turned on from the account card, `GET /shopping/{accountId}/authorize`), and otherwise publishes without it and says so on the target.

aiGenerated.description: TikTok, YouTube, X and Instagram: the media is AI-generated or realistically altered by AI. TikTok adds its « AI-generated » label (not applied to a video sent as a draft, which the creator labels in the app); YouTube records it as synthetic media; X sets `made_with_ai`; Instagram sets `is_ai_generated`. Ignored by the other platforms.

content.description: Text / caption of the post. An empty string is accepted only together with `asStory: true` — an Instagram story has no caption.

mediaItems.description: Replaces the media of the post.

platforms.description: Replaces the targets, with their per-platform overrides.

scheduledFor.description: New scheduled date (ISO 8601): the post moves to `scheduled`, unless `isDraft: true` makes it the planned date of a draft. `null` removes the date, and the post goes back to an undated draft.

isDraft.description: `true` turns the post into a draft that is never published automatically. Its date (the `scheduledFor` sent with it, or the one already set) stays as the planned date shown on the calendar. `false` schedules a draft at its planned date, which must then be in the future.

asDraft.description: TikTok only: publish as a draft (see POST /posts)

trialReel.description: Instagram only: publish the video as a trial reel (see POST /posts)

asStory.description: Instagram only: publish to the story instead of the feed (see POST /posts)

trialGraduation.description: Instagram only: how a trial reel ends (see POST /posts)

shareToFeed.description: Instagram only: also show the reel in the account feed (see POST /posts)

productTags.description: Instagram only: products to tag on the post (see POST /posts). An empty array removes the products the post was carrying.

collaborators.description: Instagram only: collaborators (see POST /posts). An empty array removes them.

userTags.description: Instagram only: tagged accounts (see POST /posts). An empty array removes them.

locationId.description: Instagram only: location Page id (see POST /posts). An empty string removes it.

firstComment.description: Instagram, Facebook Pages and Threads: first comment (see POST /posts).

coverTimestampMs.description: TikTok video / Instagram reel: cover frame in ms (see POST /posts).

coverIndex.description: TikTok photo carousel: index of the cover photo (see POST /posts).

autoAddMusic.description: TikTok photo carousel: add a recommended music track. Set to false to publish it silent.

youtubeCategoryId.description: YouTube only: category id of the video (e.g. "22" People & Blogs, "27" Education, "28" Science & Technology).

madeForKids.description: YouTube only: declare whether the video is made for kids (COPPA). When omitted, the channel default applies.

notifySubscribers.description: YouTube only: notify the channel subscribers about the new video. Set to false for a quiet upload.

topicTag.description: Threads only: topic of the post, 1 to 50 characters, without periods or ampersands.

linkAttachment.description: Threads only: a link shown as a preview card under a text post. Ignored when the post carries media.

poll.description: Poll attached to the post: Threads (text post, no media) and X. Ignored elsewhere.

xReplySettings.description: X only: who can reply. Takes precedence over `allowComment` (false maps to `mentionedUsers`).

linkedinVisibility.description: LinkedIn only: who sees the post — anyone, 1st-degree connections only, or signed-in LinkedIn members.

privacy.description: Visibility of the published video, on YouTube and TikTok (see POST /posts)

tiktokPrivacyLevel.description: TikTok only: the exact privacy level picked by the creator (see POST /posts)

promotionalContent.description: TikTok only: the video promotes the creator's own brand (see POST /posts)

paidPartnership.description: TikTok, X and Instagram: the post is a paid partnership (see POST /posts)

aiGenerated.description: TikTok, YouTube, X and Instagram: the media is AI-generated (see POST /posts)

productTags.description: The tags to put on the media. This REPLACES the tags already there. Up to 20 on a photo, 30 on a video or reel.

trigger.description: `story_reply` enrols the contact when they reply to one of the account stories — the story lead magnet ("reply BETA and I send you the link"). Narrow it with `keywords`. `dm_keyword` enrols the contact when they send a DM containing one of `keywords` (required) — for people who DM the word instead of commenting it.

automationId.description: Comment-to-DM automation that enrols people, when trigger is `comment_automation`. Shorthand for a one-item `automationIds`.

automationIds.description: Comment-to-DM automations that enrol people, when trigger is `comment_automation`. A contact who comments on several of them still enters the sequence once.

allAutomations.description: With trigger `comment_automation`: every comment-to-DM automation of the account enrols, including ones created later. Overrides `automationIds`.

oncePerContact.description: A contact enters this sequence once, ever: someone already enrolled (active, completed or stopped) is never re-enrolled — not by a new story reply or keyword DM, not by a manual enrolment.

keywords.description: Keywords that filter entry. With `story_reply`, empty means every story reply enrols; with `dm_keyword` at least one is required. Case- and accent-insensitive.

matchType.description: How `keywords` are matched against the reply or the DM.

stopOnReply.description: Stop the follow-ups as soon as the contact replies.

accountId.description: Only this account. Omit to sync every eligible account.

profileId.description: Only the accounts of this profile.

postId.description: Only this post (platform post id). Without it, the most recent posts of each account are swept — pass it to reach an older post.

message.description: The public reply to publish.

hidden.description: true hides the comment, false brings it back.

handled.description: Mark as handled (true) or put it back in the pile (false).

accounts.description: The account to use for each slot of the playbook, keyed by slot (`{"account": "acc_123"}`). Every slot listed by `GET /playbooks/{slug}` must be filled.

inputs.description: Values for the playbook inputs, keyed by input key. Anything left out falls back to the catalog default, so `{"keyword":"GUIDE","link":"https://…"}` is usually enough.

force.description: Install again on an account that already runs this playbook. Off by default: two copies send two DMs for a single comment.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the events.

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Empty or omitted means all events.

enabled.description: Pause deliveries without deleting the endpoint.

Error.description: Every error response has this shape. The request id is returned in the `x-request-id` header, not in the body.

error.description: Human-readable message (English). Informative only: branch on `type` and `code`.
error.example: scheduledFor must be a future date.

code.description: Stable machine code for the precise case (e.g. `validation_failed`, `post_not_found`, `rate_limited`, `subscription_required`).

param.description: Request field at fault, when there is one.

platform.description: Upstream platform (meta, tiktok, x…) when `type` is `platform_error`.

platformError.description: Raw error payload from the platform, passed through verbatim.

details.description: Extra structured context. Validation errors carry `details.fields` (one message per invalid field); billing errors carry `details.action_url`; rate limits carry `details.retryAfter`.

pages.description: Number of pages; 0 for an empty list.

hasMore.description: True when at least one page follows this one.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `before` on the next call to walk further back. `null` when there is nothing more.

MessageButton.description: A link button attached to a DM.

customContent.description: Per-target caption override. Absent when not overridden.

customMedia.description: Per-target media override. Absent when not overridden.

canUnpublish.description: True when `POST /posts/{id}/unpublish` can remove it from the platform.

errorMessage.description: Only on `failed`: the platform message, verbatim.

errorCategory.description: Only on `failed`: stable classification of the error.

errorSource.description: Only on `failed`: who has to act.

warning.description: Only on a non-failed target: something that was skipped without failing the publish (e.g. Instagram products not tagged).

Post.description: A post. Note: posts, accounts, profiles, webhooks, engagement items and places use `_id`; every other resource uses `id`.

platforms.description: One entry per targeted account, with its own status.

status.description: `partial` = some targets published, some failed. Follow per-target status in `platforms[]`.

trialGraduation.description: Instagram trial reels: how the reel graduates to the feed.

shareToFeed.description: Instagram reels: also shown in the grid.

tiktokPrivacyLevel.description: TikTok visibility picked by the creator (one of the account `publish-options`).

productTags.description: Instagram shop products to tag. Absent when none were requested (never `[]`).

locationId.description: Instagram: Facebook Page id of the place.

firstComment.description: Instagram, Facebook, Threads: comment posted right after.

linkAttachment.description: Threads: link preview of a text post.

AccountMetadata.description: Public platform metadata. Only keys that exist for this account are present.

currency.description: Ad accounts: every budget is in minor units of it.

AccountXBilling.description: X only: whether billable background work is allowed (X charges per call).

externalId.description: Id of the account on its platform.

disconnectedReason.description: Only when not active, if known.

disconnectedAt.description: Only when not active, if known.

reconnectUrl.description: Only when not active: where the user reconnects it.

bodyVariables.description: Number of `{{n}}` placeholders in the body.

participantId.description: Platform id (or handle) of the contact.

lastInboundAt.description: Last message from the contact: the Meta 24 h free-text window runs from here.

status.description: `undelivered` = accepted by the platform but never appeared in the thread.

mediaIds.description: Empty = every post of the account, present and future.

recipientCount.description: Frozen recipient count; `null` while still a draft.

postId.description: Platform id of the commented post.

url.description: Pass it in `mediaItems[].url`, or the `id` in `mediaIds`.

status.description: Upper-case (unlike other enums). `PENDING` = upload not finished.

mediaId.description: Library id reserved for the upload.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the raw bytes here (no auth header).

direct.description: True when the upload goes straight to storage.

mediaUrl.description: Final URL of the file once uploaded.

uploadPageUrl.description: Same ticket as a browser drop page; chunks big files for a human.

singlePutMaxBytes.description: Ceiling of a single PUT to `uploadUrl` (lower than maxBytes).

multipartUrl.description: Chunked upload entry point, when the storage supports it.

secret.description: Signing secret. Returned only once, by `POST /webhooks`.

key.description: Plaintext key. Returned only by create and roll.

maxHistoryDays.description: History depth allowed by the plan.

clamped.description: True when `from` was moved forward to fit the plan history.

change.description: Percent change vs the previous period (percentage points for rates).

AdAccount.description: Platform-native object (Meta Graph fields for `meta_ads`, a mapped subset for `google_ads`), snake_case. Budgets are in minor units of the account currency. Fields not listed may be present.

AdCampaign.description: Platform-native object (Meta Graph fields for `meta_ads`, a mapped subset for `google_ads`), snake_case. Budgets are in minor units of the account currency. Fields not listed may be present.

daily_budget.description: Minor units (string on Meta, number on Google).

AdSet.description: Platform-native object (Meta Graph fields for `meta_ads`, a mapped subset for `google_ads`), snake_case. Budgets are in minor units of the account currency. Fields not listed may be present. On Google Ads, an ad set is an ad group.

Ad.description: Platform-native object (Meta Graph fields for `meta_ads`, a mapped subset for `google_ads`), snake_case. Budgets are in minor units of the account currency. Fields not listed may be present.

AdInsight.description: Platform-native object (Meta Graph fields for `meta_ads`, a mapped subset for `google_ads`), snake_case. Budgets are in minor units of the account currency. Fields not listed may be present.

href.description: Where to edit it in the dashboard.

locationId.description: Pass it as `locationId` on a post.

ready.description: True only when a tag would really go out.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request. `code` is `validation_failed` for body/query validation (one message per field in `details.fields`), or a specific code (`invalid_reference`, `unsupported_for_platform`…).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key.

PaymentRequired.description: The billing state forbids this call (no plan, unpaid subscription, account quota reached, X spend cap reached…). `details.action_url` says where to unblock it.

example.error: Paid X API calls require a PlugKit plan — they stay locked during the free trial.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist, or does not belong to the caller.

Conflict.description: The current state of the resource forbids the operation.
